subject: SOC 2 Re-attestation — evidence handover, retention exception & capacity plan
messages:
From: Jill Tan <jill.tan@acme-platform.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence window & retention ask

Hi Chloe / Priyom,

We're starting prep for our SOC 2 re-attestation (Crowe will run the audit the week of 11/08). Two quick asks that will affect our renewal terms and audit scope:  

1) Evidence window: Crowe wants a contiguous 90–180 day evidence window for key production controls (auth logs, access reviews, deployment logs). Can you confirm what date ranges Redwood can provide as a bulk export and whether exports will include full request/response metadata?

2) Retention carve-out: our privacy group is asking for a carve-out on certain ingestion streams that contain sensitive PII (payment tokens). They'd like a configuration that keeps those pipelines at 90 days instead of the standard 180 for logs. Is that something Redwood can scope as an exception for a subset of topics?

Finally, we'll likely need a short-term increase in export throughput (S3 exports + streaming) during the audit window to hand off evidence. Can you outline capacity options and an estimated uplift cost?

Riley (procurement) is cc'd — we need any pricing impact to feed into our renewal discussion next week.

Thanks,
Jill Tan
Sr. Security Program Manager | Acme Platform
jill.tan@acme-platform.com

---
Note: attaching initial audit kickoff note to follow from Crowe.
From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Tan <jill.tan@acme-platform.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence window & retention ask

Hi Jill — thanks for the heads up and clear ask. High-level plan below; attaching an evidence index (soc2-evidence-index.csv) that maps our artifacts to Crowe's controls.

Quick answers up front:
- Evidence exports: we can provide contiguous exports covering up to 1 year, but typical packaged windows for audits are 90/180 days. Exports include request metadata, timestamps, IAM principals, and deployment hashes.
- Retention carve-outs: we can implement per-topic retention policies. We support a 90-day retention rule scoped to named ingestion topics (we'll need a list of topic names and the data types).
- Capacity uplift: for the audit export period we recommend a temporary dedicated export pool (2x medium inference nodes + burst bandwidth) to ensure no throttling. Estimated one-time export orchestration cost: $4,500 — or we can apply a renewal credit if Acme commits to the 12-month reserved capacity uplift.

Proposed timeline (sketch):
1) By 09/28: Acme to share list of sensitive topics and Crowe's control list.
2) By 10/05: Redwood will stage exports for an initial sampling & provide evidence index.
3) 10/05–10/21: Security working sessions (Redwood Sec Eng + Acme).
4) 11/08+: Full bulk export window during audit (configurable 7–14 day window).

Action items for Acme: please confirm the topic list and whether the 90-day carve-out will be limited to logs only (not metrics/alerts). Once confirmed we will:
- Create the per-topic retention policy (scoped and auditable)
- Prepare a log-retention matrix and an export plan (attached: log-retention-matrix.pdf)

If it helps, we can include a one-time 10% renewal credit toward the audit uplift cost if Acme signs the mutual action plan (MAP) by 10/01. I'll loop in Priyom and Laura for procurement/legal wording.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the index.

—
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jill Tan <jill.tan@acme-platform.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, r.owens@acme-platform.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence handover, retention ask — procurement + MAP draft

Thanks Chloe — this looks good. Internal notes and next steps from Procurement/Commercial: 

- I'll prepare a short MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx attached) that captures the 90-day evidence window, 90-day retention carve-out for the named topics, and the temporary export capacity bump.
- Commercial offer: 10% credit on the one-time export orchestration cost if MAP signed by 10/01; additionally, we can provision a 60-day trial of the dedicated export pool at no charge to validate throughput (if Acme agrees to 12-month reserved uplift after audit).
- Legal: Laura, can you draft the retention exception language (short clause limiting the carve-out to specific topics and requiring attestations that PII will be handled per Acme policy)?

Security engineering: Joanne (sec-eng) from our team should pair with Acme Security to validate exported fields and schema. Jill — would you share a short list of topic names and an example record?

I'll include the pricing items in the MAP and surface to Riley.

Thanks,
Priyom
Head of Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
From: Jill Tan <jill.tan@acme-platform.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: r.owens@acme-platform.com, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Re-attestation — evidence handover, retention exception & capacity plan

Thanks — this is timely and appreciated. Confirming next steps from Acme:

- We'll provide the topic list and two example records by EOD 09/28.
- Accept the 90-day carve-out for the flagged ingestion topics (logs only). We need the clause Laura drafts for our legal review.
- We'll take the 60-day trial of the dedicated export pool and expect Redwood to standby for validation calls with Joanne.
- Regarding credits: Riley and I will evaluate the 10% one-time credit and the renewal uplift commitment; procurement wants the MAP and pricing in the next 48 hours.

Please send the MAP (DocuSign preferred) and a proposed kickoff time for the security working session next week (we're UTC-7). Crowe will share the detailed control list by 10/04 — we may need a follow-up sprint afterward.

Appreciate the quick turn — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Jill
